titulo_ja: ないまま と ずじまい

bloques.titulo: It is not possible to do so.
texto: In this case, it is not possible for the Commission to take a decision on the application of this Regulation. The verbal form before the "can be more written."
The briefing ended without the opportunity to ask questions.
(In the end, I did not meet with the person responsible.)

frases.ja: 質問 を する 機会 が ない まま、説明会 は 終わりました。
frases.es: La sesión informativa terminó sin que surgiera la ocasión de hacer preguntas.
frases.en: The briefing ended without the opportunity to ask questions.

frases.ja: 結局、担当者 に 会わずじまい でした。
frases.es: Al final, no llegué a reunirme con la persona responsable.
frases.en: In the end, I didn't get to meet with the person responsible.
